Times tables practice

The 7 times table.

Practise the 7 times table up to 7 × 12. Use equal groups to explain multiplication, then connect each fact to division.

Practise the 7 times table

7 times table facts up to 12.

7 × 1 = 7

7 × 2 = 14

7 × 3 = 21

7 × 4 = 28

7 × 5 = 35

7 × 6 = 42

7 × 7 = 49

7 × 8 = 56

7 × 9 = 63

7 × 10 = 70

7 × 11 = 77

7 × 12 = 84

Connect multiplication and division.

7 × 4 = 28

Four equal groups of 7 make 28.

28 ÷ 7 = 4

7 × ? = 28

Try the related division fact and a missing factor after a multiplication answer. KickMaths records the different forms so that later recall is checked rather than assumed.
